vector_memory.semantic_summary: This module serves as the primary package initialization point for all voice-related functionalities within the AI system. It functions as a high-level namespace controller, organizing and exposing the interfaces provided by specific voice sub-modules. Its architectural role is to allow core system services to reliably import and interact with the entire voice stack.
vector_memory.semantic_summary_2: The component defines the entry point for voice processing components. It structures the package namespace, facilitating organized access to various voice interaction modules for the core AI services.
